procedure @@proc@@ is
begin
  for r in (select id, @@col@@ from @@tab@@) loop
    merge into @@tab2@@ t -- @expect
    using (select r.id as id from dual) s
       on (t.id = s.id)
     when matched then
       update set t.@@col@@ = r.@@col@@
     when not matched then
       insert (id) values (s.id);
  end loop;
end @@proc@@;
